resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com and the Montana Lookouts timeline give 60 ft (18.3 m). The 1940 Coast and Geodetic Survey description, reproduced on the Montana Lookouts page, says about 70 ft. Not resolved; the record keeps 60 ft and the story says the sources disagree.

notes_for_editor: Two web inventories (firelookout.com and the Montana Lookouts page) agree on a 1935 build, the 1946 cabin fire and removal about 1969. The Montana Lookouts timeline cites Kresek's inventory; I read it only through that page. Height conflict: 60 ft vs about 70 ft in the 1940 survey description; the record keeps 18.3 m. The FFLA list names the site Hog Heaven Lake. No photos added and no official record read. Story is about 150 words.
